title: EQUIPPING A GUN SAYS NOTHING ABOUT THE REST
why: His order of 2026-10-12: you do not need to be told what else is in the backpack when you equip a different gun. The gun card in the corner had a line under the gun naming the other gun you carry and its rounds (OTHER GUN), and drawing a gun off a key said where the gun it replaced went (to the backpack, back to the armoury, left behind) and which key it kept in the backpack. All of that is gone. Swapping or drawing a gun, by the number keys or on the controller, now shows the gun in your hands and its ammo, and the line that comes up names only the gun you equipped. A gun drawn off its key now reads EQUIPPED, never STOWED, since it comes straight up into your hands. The keys and the belt work exactly as before.
now: Equipping or swapping a gun now shows only the gun in your hands, with no line about your other guns or the backpack.
